query:
select
            r.longueur_billet,
            coalesce(p.quota_hebdo, r.quota_hebdo) as "quota!",
            (
                select count(*)
                from plis l
                where l.auteur_id = p.id
                  and not l.redige_par_mj
                  and l.envoye_le >= date_trunc('week', now() at time zone r.fuseau)
                                     at time zone r.fuseau
            ) as "envoyees!",
            r.delai_minutes,
            r.hasard_minutes
        from personnages p
        cross join reglages r
        where p.id = $1
